title: Pi coding agent in the browser (announcement)
brief: Announcement of a coding agent (Pi) running entirely in the browser on a 2B model via WebGPU — MiniCPM5-2B + Pi with Transformers.js and 4-bit ONNX weights. Announcement only; no repo was linked in the post.
caveat: Announcement only; no repo was linked in the post.
details: An X announcement from Victor Mustar of a coding agent (Pi) running entirely in the browser on a 2B model via WebGPU — MiniCPM5-2B with Transformers.js and 4-bit ONNX weights, matching his "MiniCPM5-2B WebGPU Pi" Hugging Face Space. Notable because it pushes a real agentic coding loop (not just chat) into a zero-install browser tab on commodity hardware. The link is the announcement only; no repo was linked in the post. (x.com is not directly fetchable from this environment; the breakdown reflects the announcement's subject as curated.)
